Rivals such as Anthropic, Meta, and xAI already have their agents making purchases.

world.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tackles the Standard Model's toughest math problem on a lattice
world.summary: OpenAI physicist Nathaniel Craig used GPT-6 Astra to tackle a problem that had stumped particle physicists for over 25 years. Craig says a lot of work remains before realistic simulations are possible.
